# Buyer Quirk Sheet — Eastern Cape Department of Health (ECDoH)

**Buyer:** Eastern Cape Department of Health (provincial department, SCM Unit 3 / SCMU3 — bids issued per health district: Chris Hani, OR Tambo, Nelson Mandela Bay/Buffalo City metro offices, Head Office)
**Kind:** Provincial department (works — JBCC-based building/electrical maintenance and repair; and services/RFP — training, consulting)
**Packs sampled:** 10 — ocds-9t57fa-164775, ocds-9t57fa-165858, ocds-9t57fa-165914, ocds-9t57fa-164773, ocds-9t57fa-165909, ocds-9t57fa-165907, ocds-9t57fa-164766, ocds-9t57fa-164770, ocds-9t57fa-164331, ocds-9t57fa-165426
**Date:** 2026-08

---

## Submission channel & rules

Electronic-only via the National Treasury eTender portal — no physical box despite leftover boilerplate referencing one.

- "Bid submissions to only be electronically through www.etenders.gov.za website." (ocds-9t57fa-164775, ocds-9t57fa-165914, ocds-9t57fa-164773, ocds-9t57fa-165909, ocds-9t57fa-165907, ocds-9t57fa-164766, ocds-9t57fa-164770)
- "Bids must be submitted in electronically through the e-tender website and all uploaded attachments to..." (ocds-9t57fa-164766)
- Quirk: the same document template still contains contradictory/unedited box language — "supporting documents must be submitted with the completed bid document in a sealed envelope in the bid box at the closing date and time" (ocds-9t57fa-164775, ocds-9t57fa-165914, ocds-9t57fa-164773, ocds-9t57fa-165909, ocds-9t57fa-165907, ocds-9t57fa-164766, ocds-9t57fa-164770). Treat the eTender-portal instruction as controlling — it is the header-level, repeated instruction, and the works packs explicitly confirm "Tenders will not be opened in public" (ocds-9t57fa-165858), consistent with electronic receipt.
- 165858 (specialised solar install) is explicit: "Bids must be submitted electronically, named 'Tender No: ...' ... At www.etenders.gov.za." (ocds-9t57fa-165858)
- The two RFP-style service packs also route through the portal: "ALL BIDS MUST BE SUBMITTED ON THE OFFICIAL FORMS PROVIDED... BID RESPONSE DOCUMENTS MAY BE SUBMITTED ONLINE VIA ETENDER PORTAL" and "All bids must be submitted via e-tender portal." (ocds-9t57fa-164331)
- Sealing/labeling: bids must be named/labelled with the exact tender number and title on upload (ocds-9t57fa-165858: "Bids must be submitted electronically, named 'Tender No: SCMU3-2627-0175-HO...'").
- No email/fax/telex tenders accepted: "Telephonic, telegraphic, telex, facsimile or e-mailed tender offers will not be accepted." (ocds-9t57fa-164775)

## Municipal-arrears / rates clause

**Not observed in sampled packs.** No "not more than X days in arrears" municipal rates/taxes clause was found in any of the 10 ECDoH packs (checked via MBD-style declarations, restricted-persons clauses, and SCM conditions). Municipal account documents appear only as an address-proof returnable, not an arrears eligibility test: "Locality Ownership: Proof of business address (municipal account or valid lease agreement)" (ocds-9t57fa-164775, ocds-9t57fa-165858, ocds-9t57fa-165914, ocds-9t57fa-164773, ocds-9t57fa-165909, ocds-9t57fa-165907, ocds-9t57fa-164766, ocds-9t57fa-164770). This is a provincial department, not a municipality, so the MBD6.1/rates-arrears wording common to municipal buyers is absent.

## B-BBEE treatment

ECDoH uses the post-2022 PPPFA "Specific Goals" regime — **not** classic B-BBEE certificate/level scoring. No hits for "BBBEE level," "B-BBEE certificate," or "BEE level" anywhere in the sample.

- "the Employer applies the two-stage process of evaluating tenders, namely functionality then Price/ BBBEE" is the only loose "BBBEE" mention, but the actual mechanism is the SBD 6.1 Specific Goals claim form (ocds-9t57fa-165858).
- Standard 80/20 split: Price 80, Specific Goals 20 (of 100), rising to 90/10 above R50m (ocds-9t57fa-164775, ocds-9t57fa-165858).
- Specific Goals breakdown is ownership-based (self-certified via CIPRO/CSD + certified ID), not a verified B-BBEE scorecard, e.g.: "Historically Disadvantaged Individuals Ownership 25%(5) / Women Ownership 20%(4) / Youth Ownership 20%(4) / Disability Ownership 20%(4) / Military Veterans Ownership 5%(1) / Locality (Chris Hani) 10%(2)" (ocds-9t57fa-164775). Weightings vary slightly by pack — one variant shows "Military Veterans Ownership 10%(2) / Locality (Chris Hani) 10%(2)" with HDI/Women/Youth/Disability at 20%(4) each (ocds-9t57fa-164775, later table in same doc).
- Distinctive sub-provincial targeting: locality points are scoped to the specific health **district** issuing the tender, not the province: "Bidders who are not from Chris Hani district will not claim points on locality." (ocds-9t57fa-164775)
- Not a hard gate — failure to submit SBD 6.1 just zeroes the Specific Goals score rather than disqualifying: "Failure will lead to the non-awarding of points for specific goals." (ocds-9t57fa-165858)

## Cure/condonation policy

ECDoH allows correction of administrative (non-material) defects on a short, explicit clock — but treats deviations that change scope/risk/competitive position as fatal and non-curable.

- Works tenders (SANS 10845-based) draw a hard line: "Reject a non-responsive tender offer, and do not allow it to be subsequently made responsive by correction or withdrawal of the non-conforming deviation or reservation." A deviation is material (fatal) if it would "detrimentally affect the scope, quality, or performance," "significantly change the employer's or the tenderer's risks," or "affect the competitive position of other tenderers ... if it were to be rectified." (ocds-9t57fa-164775)
- RFP/services tenders explicitly allow a documented cure window for administrative gaps: "give the Bidder an opportunity to submit and/or supplement the information ... provided that such information ... can be provided within a period of 7 (seven) days ... and is administrative in nature, as opposed to forming a material part of the Bidder's Bid" (ocds-9t57fa-164331).
- Tax-compliance status gets its own 7-day cure: "In cases where the bidder's status is found non-compliant, the bidder will be granted 7 days to correct the status. A bidder that fails to rectify its tax matters with SARS will be declared non-responsive." (ocds-9t57fa-165858)
- Arithmetic/words-vs-figures discrepancies are resolved administratively, not treated as fatal: "Where there is a discrepancy between the amounts in figures and the amount in words, the amount in words shall govern." (ocds-9t57fa-164775, ocds-9t57fa-165858, and others in sample)

## Security/vetting requirements

- Post-adjudication site/risk vetting for shortlisted bidders on at least one (specialised, higher-value) works tender: "Shortlisted tenderers (typically the top 3 to 4) will be subject to a Post-Adjudication Risk Verification and may involve an office visit. The award of the contract is contingent upon the tenderer achieving a favourable (Low) risk rating during this phase." (ocds-9t57fa-165858)
- Personnel/officer-level security clearance is reserved as a right for services contracts, applied after appointment: "In the event that the bidder is appointed pursuant to this invitation to bid such bidder may be subject to security clearance prior to commencement of the Services." (ocds-9t57fa-164331, ocds-9t57fa-165426 — identical clause in both)
- POPIA consent is a standing, recurring requirement across the whole sample, framed as a bidder obligation plus a full department-drafted POPIA agreement annexed to the bid pack: "Protection of personal information: Consent (POPIA)" appears as a mandatory line item (ocds-9t57fa-164775, ocds-9t57fa-165858), backed by a full POPIA clause: "the Department of Health requires that Bidders which receive or have access to its personal information, process any such information in a manner compliant with the requirements of the POPIA." (ocds-9t57fa-164775)
- No integrity-pact requirement observed in the sample.

## Financial demands

- Performance security is deferred to post-award, not required at bid stage: "the preferred tenderer will be required to submit an approved insurer undertaking to provide the Performance Bond / Guarantee / Surety / Security to the format and/or standard" — one pack quantifies the deadline as "within 21 days after the appointment" (ocds-9t57fa-165858; same clause without the deadline in ocds-9t57fa-164775).
- Works packs (JBCC) carry a detailed employer/contractor insurance schedule as a pricing annexure: "B 6.0 Insurances [10.0] ... Contract works insurance / Supplementary insurance / Public liability insurance / Removal of lateral support insurance" (ocds-9t57fa-164775, ocds-9t57fa-165858) — amounts are left blank/N/A in these particular repair-scale packs (no minimum Rand figure specified in the sample).
- RFP/services packs (goods/consulting form of contract) require a bank-issued performance security or letter of credit: "a bank guarantee or an irrevocable letter of credit issued by a reputable bank located in the purchaser's country or abroad, acceptable to the purchaser" (ocds-9t57fa-164331).
- Financial standing letter or audited statements required as a bid returnable, with an explicit fallback to non-responsiveness: "Documentary proof confirming availability of financial resources ... in the form of a rating letter or financial statements. If this requirement is not complied with in full the bid may be considered invalid." and "Bidders must submit financial statements that are not older than a year to assess financial viability." (ocds-9t57fa-164331)
- CIDB grading is a hard mandatory gate for works tenders, checked at both bid and award stage: "Bidders must be registered with CIDB in the correct grading and class of works... The status on CIDB must be active during award stage. It is the responsibility of the bidder to keep the status on CIDB active throughout the bidding process." (ocds-9t57fa-164775, and equivalent in all seven works packs)

## Functionality norms

Sharply bimodal by procurement type within this buyer:

- Routine JBCC minor-repair/maintenance packs skip functionality scoring entirely: "Scoring quality / functionality: Not applicable to this tender." (ocds-9t57fa-164775, ocds-9t57fa-165914, ocds-9t57fa-164773, ocds-9t57fa-165909, ocds-9t57fa-165907, ocds-9t57fa-164766, ocds-9t57fa-164770) — bid moves straight from admin/mandatory compliance to Price + Specific Goals.
- Specialised/higher-value works and RFP/services packs impose a 70% functionality threshold as a hard gate: "Scoring Functionality threshold for this Tender is 70%. Failure to meet this threshold will lead to disqualification of the Tenderer." (ocds-9t57fa-165858); the training RFP sets an equivalent bar in raw points — "Bidder must obtain a minimum threshold of 70 points out of 80 to proceed to the next stage. A bidder who scores less than 70 points will not be considered further." (ocds-9t57fa-164331, i.e. 87.5%).
- Functionality criteria style is experience/reference-and-credential based with tiered point bands, e.g. "4 x References = 20 / 3 x References = 10 / 2 x References = 0" and "Valid Proof = 20 / No proof = 0" (ocds-9t57fa-164331); on works tenders it centers on named key staff, whose omission is separately fatal regardless of functionality scoring: "Submission of All key staff: ... Omission of even one of them will render the tender as non-responsive ... however, the supporting CVs and Qualifications are administrative and will be scored zero for functionality if missing." (ocds-9t57fa-165858)
- Functionality is also used as the final tiebreaker after price and Specific Goals are equal: "the functionality is part of the evaluation process and in the event that two or more Tenders have scored equal points including preference points for Specific Goals, the successful Tender must be the one scoring the highest score for functionality." (ocds-9t57fa-165858)

## Distinctive kill rules / quirks

- **District-scoped locality points, not provincial**: preference is tied to the specific health district running the bid (e.g. Chris Hani), and bidders outside that district are told outright they cannot claim the points — a finer-grained localisation than the usual "province-wide" locality preference: "Bidders who are not from Chris Hani district will not claim points on locality." (ocds-9t57fa-164775)
- **Template drift between box and portal instructions**: every works pack in the sample retains dead "sealed envelope in the bid box" language alongside the controlling "electronically through www.etenders.gov.za" instruction — a documentation-hygiene quirk bidders should not be misled by (ocds-9t57fa-164775 and six sibling packs).
- **Mandatory named-key-staff rule, separate from functionality**: omitting even one required named key staff member makes the bid non-responsive outright, independent of whatever functionality points their CV would have earned (ocds-9t57fa-165858).
- **"No briefing meeting" is the norm on routine works packs, but attendance is compulsory when a briefing is held**: seven of the seven routine JBCC packs explicitly state "There will be no briefing meeting however it is at the discretion, and best interest, of the bidders" (ocds-9t57fa-164775, ocds-9t57fa-165914, ocds-9t57fa-164773, ocds-9t57fa-165909, ocds-9t57fa-165907, ocds-9t57fa-164766, ocds-9t57fa-164770), while the specialised solar-install pack makes attendance a hard eliminating requirement: "Attendance of compulsory briefing meeting. The bidders' name must appear on the official attendance list from the virtual meeting." (ocds-9t57fa-165858)
- **State-employee/close-family disclosure gate**: an absolute bar, stated in capitals in the RFP template, distinct from the usual conflict-of-interest declaration: "NO BIDS WILL BE CONSIDERED FROM PERSONS IN THE SERVICE OF THE STATE, COMPANIES WITH DIRECTORS WHO ARE PERSONS IN THE SERVICE OF THE STATE, OR CLOSE CORPORATIONS WITH MEMBERS PERSONS IN THE SERVICE OF THE STATE." (ocds-9t57fa-164775), reinforced by a 12-month look-back on former state employees (ocds-9t57fa-164775, clause 8/"has been in the service of the state in the previous twelve months").
- **Post-adjudication site/risk verification gate for shortlisted bidders** on higher-value works — award is conditional on a "favourable (Low) risk rating" from an office visit conducted after adjudication but before award (ocds-9t57fa-165858) — functions as an informal vetting layer beyond standard CSD/tax checks.
